capabilities: Map file extensions to Obsidian view types via a JSON config setting
Edit a file's extension from the file-tree context menu
View current extension-to-view associations and configuration errors in the settings tab
Set a separate mobile extension config
List all registered view types for the vault
disambiguation: Not a file manager or converter; it only controls which view opens an extension and renames extensions, it does not move or reformat files.
extras: The .md extension cannot be reassigned; an 'Allow md Extension Override' toggle exists but the Notes section says .md will always be set to the markdown view. The README positions the plugin as useful for supporting other plugins that register new view types.
problem: Obsidian decides internally which view opens each file extension, so users cannot control how non-markdown or plugin-provided file types open.
summary: Settings-driven tool that maps file extensions to Obsidian view types and lets users edit a file's extension from the file tree.
